findings.evidence: Row claims version_status "published" with version "rtx-pro-6000". Under c2, "published" requires the maintainer to publish a release identifier for this board which the version copies. The primary evidence (leaderboard.json schema_version 1, SPEC.md, kernelbench.com page) publishes no release identifier for this board; schema_version 1 is a data-format version, not a board release id, and "rtx-pro-6000" is a hardware identity. A page that publishes no release identifier supports "snapshot", so this is a mismatch, not missing evidence.
findings.repair: Set version_status to "snapshot" and version to the dated identity snapshot-<date> the registry wrote, or supply evidence of a maintainer-published release identifier for this board.

findings.evidence: Notes claim the ranked list 'still holds the two audited-but-excluded cells ... the `bug` muse/muse-spark-1.3 [ultra] cell on 04 (0.2056)'. Source 2 shows muse/muse-spark-1.3 [ultra] on 04_grid_mingru_sps with correct:false, peak_fraction null, annotation_verdict "bug", and that cell is absent from the per_problem 04 ranked_passes list (top value there is or-opus 1.961; muse appears only on 01/02/03). The value 0.2056 appears nowhere in the evidence and the muse-04 cell is not in the ranked list, contradicting the claimed transcription on both value and presence.
findings.repair: Correct the note: the muse-04 cell is a `bug` cell with peak_fraction null (correct:false) and is absent from the ranked list; the only audited-but-excluded cell present in the ranked list is the `suspect` kinetic-claude/kinetic-0715[1m] cell on 03 at 0.0622 (which does match Source 2).
